title: Joomla 3 saves 500ing: the missing #__assets row, found in 40 minutes
lede: A Joomla 3 site started throwing 500s the moment an editor hit Save. The cause was a single missing row in #__assets. Here is the trace, with SQL.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of handwritten Joomla incident sheet, assets table schematic, manila folder tab, brass key, wax seal envelope.
